# 24. The report cache never grows past 50 MB

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Proposed (drafted by an agent; awaiting confirmation by the coordinator)

## Context

The kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. Mira said: "FYI the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never grow past 50 MB." Reports were slow to load, and the choice was between an in-memory LRU cache and an index on the existing SQLite cache. Ruling 8 says report data is never cached only in process memory, so the SQLite index was chosen.

## Decision

**Words:** 「The report cache must never grow past 50 MB.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-21

The report cache must never grow past 50 MB. This is a hard limit, not a target. It applies to the SQLite cache file under data/ and to any report data held in process memory. Any change to the cache must enforce the limit, for example by evicting the oldest entries.

## Consequences

Later work on the report cache follows this limit until a newer record supersedes it. It works together with ruling 7 (entries expire after 24 hours) and ruling 8 (SQLite file on disk).
EOF

input.decision: Chose sqlite_index: ADR 0008 says report data is never cached only in process memory, and the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM. I recorded Mira's 50 MB cache limit as a new proposed ADR in this repo. I didn't implement anything or commit.
